title: Retro lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Retro templates were built and verified in: 80s action title, mixtape tracklist, under construction page, film countdown leader, pixel level up, 70s TV ident, polaroid memory and retro weather map.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 retro template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a retro film, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.

comps: RT Action title (150 f, ground included)
RT Under construction (150 f, ground included, seamless hazard bands)
RT Film leader (120 f, 4 beats of 30 f)
RT TV ident (150 f, ground included)
RT Weather map (150 f, sea included)

parameters: text content (sample copy: titles, songs, towns, dates and numbers are invented)
the lists in retro_lab3.py (TRACKS, SPRITE, ISLAND, CITIES)
the photo stand-in (replace with a real picture)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The polaroid photo is a gradient stand-in.
RT Mixtape, RT Level up and RT Polaroid have a 'Lab bg' rectangle, dropped on extraction; the other comps keep their own ground (Title ground, Page ground, Leader ground, Ident ground, Sea).
Clip ids are unique per comp (rat_, rmx_, ruc_, rfl_, rlu_, rti_, rpo_, rwm_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/retro_lab3.py; every move is baked as keys (on twos with Hold), no presets to apply; open the file and edit.save.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings; the notes are speed_jump on the stepped (on twos) moves plus one outside_graphics_safe while the polaroid drops in. qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
